title: Kummer Nerve Geometric Map
statement: Given the actual punctured constant-module identification, derive its pullback along the canonical root-coordinate map using the exact degree-zero and point-pullback comparisons. Restrict the actual derived nerve image along that map by its actual unit, transport the identical structural maps, and follow the normalized full-root parameterized geometric map. This is a morphism of derived module sheaves on the entire boundary scheme. Built from [def-sfb-kummer-constant-nerve-term], [def-sfb-kummer-parameterized-term], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].
